summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers (monai/data/csv_saver.py, monai/data/nifti_saver.py), the plot_2d_or_3d_image function in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, and thin delegating adapters in the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers. Updated the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32, renamed output_path to output_dir in two examples and the sliding-window integration test, and added/updated the five specified test files. Nothing was run (per instructions), so tests and flake8 are unverified; static checks (line length, file endings, leftover output_path) pass. Nothing committed.
